recommendations.name: West Face / South Summit (Standard)
recommendations.summary: Keep this as the climb to Chimney Rock's lower South Peak up the east-side gully to the notch, rename it to say so, and strip out the west-face pitches and rappels, which were copied from a different Chimney Rock in Idaho.
recommendations.detail: No source documents a west-face route on Washington's Chimney Rock, but a documented ascent of its minor South Peak (7,440 ft) does exist: from the Chimney Glacier, up the East Gully, about three pitches (~600 ft) of wet, slippery 4th-class ground and ledges left of the main gully to the notch between the central and south summits, then about 400 ft more to the South Peak, descending the same ledges with single-rope rappels over the steep bits. The row's beta, grade (4th class), 7,440 ft high point, shared Pete Lake/Sunrise Knob approach and the 'notch between the summits' waypoint note already describe that line. Everything built around the 'Rappel Chimney' (the start 30-40 ft right of it, the ladder-like chimney, the rocking summit block, the 40 ft rap to the northwest shoulder, the two-rope rap, the 5.6 pitch table) belongs to the Idaho Selkirks Chimney Rock West Face and must go. Rename to something like 'South Peak via East Gully', set aspect to E, and set grade to 4th class with a single rope; no pitch-by-pitch table exists for the Washington line, so pitch_detail should be emptied rather than rewritten.

recommendations.name: North Norwegian Buttress
recommendations.summary: Turn this row into the Jötnar aid route and create a second row for Bluebell, the separate free route, moving the pitch-by-pitch breakdown, the rappel plan and the free-ascent credit onto the new Bluebell row.
recommendations.detail: The row is named for the wall and fuses two independent, well-documented lines: Jötnar (VI 5.9 A3+, 16 pitches, 2,000 ft; first ascent Sam Boyce, Lani Chapko and Kyle Willis, June-July 2020, about 100 yards left of the 1980s Doorish route) and Bluebell (5.13-, 2,000 ft, 17 pitches on its route page / 21 in the journal report, all anchors bolted, rappelled on a single 70 m rope; first free ascent Nathan Hadley, August 2023), which the journal says is completely independent of earlier lines, not a free version of any of them. The row's grade, pitch count, commitment, aid grade, aid gear and portaledge advice are Jötnar's; its pitch_detail (Toe/Shield/Roofs/Slab/Headwall/Summit), rappels, descent, descent_text, 70 m single-rope and bolted-anchor gear lines, and the free-ascent half of fa are Bluebell's. The fa field is also wrong for both: Doorish's solo was a different line; set Jötnar's fa to the 2020 party. Approach, access, road, permit and emergency fields are shared by both and can be copied to the new row; Jötnar's descent should say what its report says (lowering and rappelling its own anchors), not the single-70 m claim.

recommendations.name: East Ridge
recommendations.summary: Move this climb from Red Mountain to Lundin Peak, the neighbouring peak it actually climbs, and correct its summit height and the few sentences that describe Red Mountain.
recommendations.detail: The short easy-5th East Ridge with three oversized bolts, starting at the saddle between Lundin and East Lundin peaks and approached over Red Pass, is filed on its route page under Lundin Peak, and two independent trip reports describe the same bolted final ridge to Lundin's main summit. Nothing in the row is about Red Mountain except where it was filed, so it should move to the Lundin Peak area (no Lundin area id appears in the data given; create or find it). After the move, high_point_ft (5,890 ft is Red Mountain's height) must become Lundin's summit height, the overview's 'ridge above Red Pass' wording should name Lundin, and the hazard comparing the rock to 'the south face' (Red Mountain's South Face sibling) should be reworded.

recommendations.name: Tepeh Towers
recommendations.summary: Move Tepeh Towers out from under Eldorado Peak's main summit into its own formation entry, so the page header stops showing Eldorado's summit height, and delete the sentences that apologise for the filing.
recommendations.detail: Tepeh Towers is a separate arete on the northwest side of the Inspiration Glacier, dividing it from the McAllister Glacier, about 45 minutes' glacier walk from the Eldorado East Ridge camp; it is not on Eldorado Peak. It was filed under Eldorado's main summit because the climbing database it came from files it there, which puts Eldorado's 8,872 ft in the header while the route itself tops out at 8,113 ft. The route content (one short low-5th pitch above the moat, scramble to the top, rappel back to the glacier) is correct. Refile it to a new Tepeh Towers area placed under the Eldorado/Inspiration Glacier parent (a sibling of Eldorado's main summit, not a child of it), then remove the 'this route is NOT on Eldorado Peak despite being filed under the same area' wording and the unrelated Klawatti/Austera travel detail from the approach text.

recommendations.name: West Route
recommendations.summary: Fold this row into the existing Agnes Mountain South Ridge route, keeping only the note about the 1936 first ascent from the West Fork as history, because everything else on it already describes the South Ridge climb.
recommendations.detail: The only documented facts about a west-side line are that the 1936 first ascent (W. Ronald Frazier and Dan O'Brien) came up from the West Fork of Agnes Creek; no source gives its route, grade or pitches, and the old West Fork trail has largely vanished into bushwhack. The recommended route is Asa Peak's northeast ridge to Agnes's south ridge with technical sections to 5.6 (a 5.8 chimney in one report), and this row's approach, climbing_route, approach_variants, descent_text and rappel information all describe that line, duplicating wa_agnes_mountain_south_ridge while calling it 'Class 3-4'. Merge into wa_agnes_mountain_south_ridge and remove this row; carry over only the 1936 first-ascent history and the rarely-climbed note (second ascent 1969, fourteen parties by 1987) into that row's overview if it lacks them.
